newsitem.title: POLAND: Rafako June sales flat at PLN 31.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Rafako June sales flat at PLN 31.5 mln.

text.p: Polish industrial boilermaker Rafako SA, suspended from Warsaw bourse trade since July 11 due to flooding, said in a statement that sales in June were roughly flat from June last year at 31.5 million zlotys.

Rafako said that due to the flooding the remainder of its June earnings report would appear on August 4, adding that the firm had not yet appraised the amount of flood damage at its plant in the badly affected southern town of Raciborz.
